details:
VRChat content creators can benefit from having an advance camera system. While also having an advance camera, they should also maintain having the regular camera. The advance camera system should utilize having more advance controls and settings such as: 

Track camera path- this allows a player to plot a series of points in a world. The points can be used by a camera. The player can set certain speeds to the points which affects the speed of the camera.  The player can also enable points to slow in and slow out (camera slowly comes to a stop or the camera slowly accelerates onto a path). 

Multiple cameras- Ability to have three cameras in a scene at the same time and record at the same time. 

Free roam camera- A free roam camera acts as a flying drone camera where a player can control the speed and where the camera goes around the world. 

Camera effects-The advance camera will have a variety of options such as:  bloom, darkness value, Depth of field [close field of view, far field of view], turn off name tags, custom filters (black and white, color gradients, and perhaps unique shader filters [retro grain, black and white ink outlines, toon, diffuse only, high contrast, moderate saturation]), camera type (wide view, 3D VR, panorama), stabilization (allows player to walk with a camera and the camera stays still), zoom in and zoom out, change lens perspective amount (perspective to orthographic using a range or slider). 

Lighting- allows player to spawn: point lights, spot lights, directional light, ambient light, area lights, and features where each light can be modified (intensity, range [inner limit, outter limit], and color). 

Green screen- spawns a green screen and allows the player to set the size of the green screen plane. 

Camera recording screen- This shows a large plane of what a player is recording. The plane, just like the green screen, can be modified in size. 

Also in addition, and separate from the advance camera, I want to also add to increase the radius in which a player can interact with buttons on the current existing camera. 

In conclusion, I think having an advance camera will allow content creators to make game series, movies, shows, and enables the execution of a variety of creative ideas. I think this will help inspire more content creators and overall add more value to VRChat. 

... ~Awoo.
title: Advance Camera
